title: 研修と話し合いの言葉
label: BJT · 第3課

screen.subject: 新入社員研修（案）
screen.line: ロールプレイ中心に変更

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 3: 25 words — training & discussion.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a meeting about training for new employees.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today I'd like to discuss the content of next month's new-employee training.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Yes. In last year's training, many new staff couldn't respond appropriately on the phone.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Specifically, what problems were there?
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Sometimes they couldn't correctly grasp what the caller wanted. Even when they took a message, they hung up without confirming it.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: I see. Knowing keigo doesn't mean you can use it in real communication.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Right. So this year I want to change the format from lectures to mainly role-play.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Good. What kind of people will the role-plays assume?
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: I'll prepare several situations, such as a client in a hurry or an angry customer.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: They also need practice understanding how the other person feels and asking questions calmly.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Exactly. At the end, I'll also set aside time for each person to state what they learned.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: How will you assess them?
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: I'll look not only at accurate expression but also at the ability to adjust to the other person.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Understood. Please also ask the senior staff involved in the training for their cooperation.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Will do. Could you also check the last part of the materials? I'll contact you when the draft is ready.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Of course. If we can show the results in numbers, reporting to the manager will be easier too.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: discussion & contact.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thinking something over carefully.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll consider the new plan by next week.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Letting someone know information.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: If you'll be late, let us know right away.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: A message passed on through someone else.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I have a message for you from Tanaka.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Checking carefully that something is right.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Check the address before you send it.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Putting your thoughts or opinion into words.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I stated my opinion at the meeting.
lines.name: 中村

segments.meaning: to ask, put a question to

lines.en: Putting a question to someone.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The lecturer put a question to everyone.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: People sharing feelings and information with each other.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We value communication within the team.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Acting to suit the person or the situation.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I dealt with the customer's question right away.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Showing thoughts or feelings, for example in words.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: In business we use polite expressions.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Next: thinking & understanding.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Understanding the meaning or content well.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I listened to the explanation and understood it.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Getting a firm grasp of the whole picture.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's get a clear picture of the cause.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: What you know from study or experience.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Knowledge of the law helped in my work.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: The ability to do things.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This job requires Japanese ability.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: A problem that still has to be solved.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Next year's challenge is lowering costs.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Being just right for the situation.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Choose words that fit the situation.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Showing something so that it is clear.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll show the results in a graph.
lines.name: 木村

segments.meaning: to be involved in, relate to

lines.en: Being connected with or involved in something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Ten people are involved in this project.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Last: situations & forms.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The case when something happens.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: If it rains, we'll hold it in the meeting room.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: How things stand at that moment.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please report the current situation.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: The time or place where something happens.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: It's an expression often used on the phone.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: What a talk or text actually says.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I read the content of the email again.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: A set form or way of doing something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please write the report in this format.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: One part of the whole.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll explain this part in a bit more detail.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: A particular person.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The person in the photo is our company president.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Changing something that was decided.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The meeting time was changed to three.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: I ___ my opinion at the meeting.

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 述べました, I stated my opinion.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: If you'll be late, ___ us right away.

lines.en: Question 2. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 連絡, let us know.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Getting a firm grasp of the whole picture.

lines.en: Question 3. What do you call getting a firm grasp of the whole picture?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 把握.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: The meeting time was ___ to three.

lines.en: Question 4. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: 変更, it was changed.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 5. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 適切, appropriate words.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today we studied 25 words: training & discussion.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Review them again in the app's word list.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Good work today. See you in the next lesson.
lines.name: ナレーター
